title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Revelation 19: the hallelujahs in heaven, the wedding supper of the Lamb, and the rider on the white horse.

questions.text: What did the loud voice of the great multitude in heaven say belongs to our God?
questions.explanation: The great multitude said, "Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God."

questions.text: What did a second voice say about her smoke?
questions.explanation: A second said, "Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever."

answers.text: It goes up forever and ever
It was blown away by the wind

questions.text: Who fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying "Amen! Hallelujah!"?
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:4 says the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne.

answers.text: The kings of the earth and their armies
The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures
The seven angels who had the seven bowls
All the birds that fly in the sky

questions.text: What reason did the great multitude give for rejoicing and being exceedingly glad?
questions.explanation: They rejoiced because the wedding of the Lamb had come and his wife had made herself ready.

answers.text: The nations had been gathered to war
The wedding of the Lamb had come

questions.text: What does the text say the bright, pure, fine linen is?
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:8 says that the fine linen she was given to wear is the righteous acts of the saints.

answers.text: The righteous acts of the saints

questions.text: Who are called blessed in the words the speaker was told to write down?
questions.explanation: He was told to write, "Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb."

answers.text: Those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb
Those who keep the words of this book
Those who die in the Lord
Those who worship before the throne

questions.text: What is on the head of him who sat on the white horse?
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:12 says his eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns.

questions.text: What proceeds out of the mouth of the rider?
questions.explanation: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, with which he should strike the nations.

questions.text: What name is written on his garment and on his thigh?
questions.explanation: Revelation 19:16 says he has a name written on his garment and on his thigh: "KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS."

answers.text: "KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS"
"The Lion of the tribe of Judah"

questions.text: Who were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur?
questions.explanation: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet, and these two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

answers.text: The beast and the false prophet
